name: @pipeworx/mcp-ecb

tools.name: ecb_policy_rate
tools.description: The European Central Bank's three official key interest rates — the deposit facility rate (the ECB's primary policy rate since the 2024 operational-framework reform), the main refinancing operations rate, and the marginal lending facility rate. For each: the current rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history (FM flow, series DFR/MRR_FR/MLFR). Use this for "ECB interest rate" / "ECB deposit rate" / "has the ECB cut rates" instead of guessing an FM series key.

tools.name: ecb_exchange_rate
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE euro foreign-exchange reference rate from the European Central Bank — the official daily EUR spot rate against a target currency (ISO 4217: USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, ...). Use for "current EUR/USD rate", "EURUSD spot", "what is the euro worth in dollars", and for historical FX series. Returns `latest` ({period, value}) for the current rate plus recent labeled observations; pass start_period/end_period (or last_n) for a longer history. This is the published mid-market reference rate, not a dealer or exchange quote, so there is no bid/ask spread.

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations. Defaults to 30 when no start_period is given.

frequency.description: Observation frequency — D (daily), M (monthly), Q (quarterly), A (annual). Default D.

tools.name: ecb_hicp_inflation
tools.description: Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) annual rate of change for a country / euro area. Monthly frequency. country defaults to U2 (euro area).

country.description: Reference area — U2 (euro area, default), DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, BE, etc.

tools.name: ecb_get_data
tools.description: Generic SDMX data fetch from any ECB flow. Key is dot-separated dimension values; empty positions are wildcards. Example: flow_ref="EXR", key="D.USD.EUR.SP00.A" (daily USD/EUR spot).

flow_ref.description: Flow reference — EXR (exchange rates), ICP (HICP), BSI, IRS, STS, BLS, MIR, ...

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations

tools.name: ecb_list_dataflows
tools.description: List all ECB SDMX dataflow IDs and names (e.g. EXR, ICP, BSI, MIR). Accepts an optional case-insensitive substring filter on flow_ref or name. Returns {count, total_dataflows, dataflows: [{flow_ref, name}]} — flow_ref is exactly what ecb_get_data takes as its flow_ref argument.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ecb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ecb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
